sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: Clock calibration unit interrupt enable register (FDCAN_CCU_IE)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.7.6 "Clock calibration unit interrupt enable register (FDCAN_CCU_IE)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3745.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0014
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
The settings in the CU interrupt enable register determine whether a status change in the
CU interrupt register is signaled on an interrupt line.
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 CSCE: Calibration state changed enable
0: Interrupt disabled
1: Interrupt enabled
Bit 0 CWEE: Calibration watchdog event enable
0: Interrupt disabled
1: Interrupt enabled

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
